correctness.rationale: PASS: Irreducibility identifies F_p^d and the order-L element; gcd(L,p-1)=1 makes any nontrivial mod-p power non-scalar, hence distinct lag rows independent. A^L=I+pB and centralizer F_p^d with non-scalar B guarantees B is nonzero/invertible and the rows ell,ell B independent. Odd-p binomial lifting gives exact period T_k=Lp^(k-1) for every primitive state; N_k=(p-1)p^((d-1)(k-1)). For lag divisible by L with valuation j, the pair constraints row-reduce to x1=0,p^j x2=0; primitive solutions count (p^(d-2)-1)p^((d-2)(k-1)+j). Other lag counts and the diagonal give mean (p^(d-1)-1)/(p-1) and variance (p^(d-2)-1)(k-1). Independently enumerated all primitive cubic p=3,k=1,2,3 cycles and moments. Hypotheses d≥3, odd p, gcd(d,p-1)=1, nonscalar lift all used, k=1 checked.
residual_risks: Conditional on irreducible order-L reduction and non-scalar lift; d≥3, odd p, all k; no claims about arbitrary matrices.
